name: Beer-Battered Fish Burgers
subtitle: Crisp fish fillets with dill pickle mayonnaise and quick-pickled onion
description: Fried battered fish fillets are tucked into soft buns with lettuce, tangy pickle mayonnaise, and lightly pickled red onion.

ingredients.item: thick skinless fillets of cod pollock or haddock (100g-120g each)
a few lettuce leaves (round lettuce works well)
red onion sliced into rings (not too thin)

ingredients.preparation: plus 1 sliced gherkin to serve (optional), and a splash of the brine

ingredients.item: self-raising flour plus extra for dusting
pinch each of ground turmeric and cayenne pepper

instructions.text: Toss the red onion with the malt vinegar and half of the turmeric and cayenne. Set aside while preparing the other components.
Stir the chopped gherkin, dill, mayonnaise, and a splash of gherkin brine together. Set aside.
Mix the self-raising flour, cornflour, and the remaining turmeric and cayenne. Whisk in the cold lager or fizzy water until a smooth, thick batter forms.
Pat the fish dry and dust it lightly with the extra flour. Heat the sunflower oil in a deep, heavy pan until hot enough to sizzle a little batter immediately.

Dip the fish in the batter, letting excess drip off, then fry in batches until golden and crisp and the fish reaches 145°F internally or is opaque and flakes easily, about 4 minutes per fillet. Drain well.
Split the buns and fill them with lettuce, fried fish, pickled onion, and the gherkin mayonnaise. Add the optional sliced gherkin to serve.
